metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP XXE Prevention Cheat Sheet

description: XXE occurs when XML parser processes external entities, allowing attacker to read files, SSRF, etc.

methodology.recon: Identify endpoints that accept XML: API with Content-Type application/xml, file upload XML, etc.
testing: Test with <!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>]> and use &xxe; in XML
Test with out-of-band via http://collaborator (with approval)
methodology.evidence: Request with XXE payload returns file content or internal data, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with file read payload, confirm file content, check if external entity processing enabled

remediation: Disable external entities, use JSON, patch XML parser, validate XML
